tool.name: Extract IC
tool.description: Extract initial conditions from EnSight output (NDTTR scalar or tar.gz)

param.name: input
param.label: EnSight output (.ensi.tar.gz or single NDTTR file)
param.help: Accepts a tar.gz archive from the transient solver (picks the last NDTTR file) or a single NDTTR scalar file.

tool.help:
Extracts per-node initial conditions from EnSight Gold transient thermal output.
Accepts: - A ``.ensi.tar.gz`` archive produced by the transient solver (picks the last NDTTR timestep) - A single EnSight scalar file (e.g. ``job.ensi.NDTTR-000010``)
Output is a ``.ini`` file with node count on line 1, followed by one temperature value per node. Feed this into the transient solver's *From .ini file* initial condition mode to resume from a saved state.
